**Finding submitted: deviation (critical) — Section 20 / p0080.**

- **Issue:** The Agreement's only indemnity runs one way — Customer indemnifies Vendor for "every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services." There is no Vendor indemnity of any kind, including for third-party IP infringement, which is the playbook's walk-away scenario (it fails both preferred and fallback). Section 9.3 also relies on remedies "required by Section 20.5," a provision that does not exist in the document.
- **Redline (validated, preferred level):** Recast 20.1 as a Vendor defence/indemnity for (a) IP infringement by the Services or Deliverables, (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, (c) Vendor-caused unauthorized access to Customer Data, and (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct; added 20.2 customary exclusions (Customer modifications, combinations, Customer specifications), 20.3 notice/control/cooperation procedure, 20.4 a narrowed Customer indemnity (Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law), and 20.5 procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, which also cures the broken Section 9.3 cross-reference.
